name: After Image Trail
description: Renders copies of the entity behind it.

fields.description: Defines the color/tint of the after image
Starting opacity of the after image
If enabled, the after image is rendered as a flat, fullbright silhouette in the given color instead of a tinted copy of the entity's textures
If enabled, only high-contrast edges of the entity's textures are rendered as fullbright lines in the given color, the rest is mostly transparent
Amount of times each after image is rendered on top of itself, each layer slightly scaled up, to create a blurry outline
How much each additional blur layer is scaled up

name: Gradient Trail
description: Renders a colored gradient behind the players.

fields.description: Defines the color of the gradient
Starting opacity of the gradient
Defines the orientation in relation to the entity in which the gradient will render
Defines where the gradient will start in relation to entity hitbox. 0.5 is equal to the center.
Defines how many lightnings will follow the player
Box (in blocks) the lightning spreads within. Scales with the size of the entity. Defaults to the entity hitbox.
The render settings for the lightning.

name: Lightning Aura Trail
description: Renders independently growing lightning arcs with branches around an entity (inspired by DCEU Flash).

fields.description: Arcs created per timer event
Branches created for each arc
Segments in each arc
Ticks required for an arc to fully grow
The render settings for the arcs.
Arc range, branch timing, jitter, and block-target search settings. Ranges, distances and jitter scale with the size of the entity.
fields.fallback: ArcSettings[idleRange=4.5, runningRange=8.0, sprintingRange=11.0, sideRangeMultiplier=0.7, rearRangeMultiplier=1.2, branchStartMin=0.22, branchStartMax=0.6, branchDelayMin=0.08, branchDelayMax=0.3, jitterAmount=0.055, jitterSpeed=0.27, searchDirections=64, minimumTargetDistance=0.75]

name: Motion Blur Trail
description: A short, translucent, tapering ribbon built from the entity's recent positions that reads as a motion blur, with optional thin secondary streaks and surface dust. It follows the entity's actual speed: nothing is drawn below minimum_trail_speed, and length, opacity and width grow smoothly towards maximum_trail_speed. Use with tick_delay 1 and a lifetime of at least max_age.

fields.description: Texture drawn along the ribbon. The first axis runs from the entity to the tail, the second across the ribbon, with the soft centre in the middle.
Main colour of the blur.
Colour the centre moves towards at high speed.
Colour of the faint outer boundary.
Opacity at full intensity, before the speed opacity multiplier.
Ribbon width in blocks next to the entity.
Ribbon width in blocks at the oldest end.
Exponent of the taper. 1 is linear, higher keeps the ribbon wide for longer before narrowing.
Height in blocks of the vertical sheet crossing the ribbon. 0 draws only the flat sheet.
Ticks a ribbon segment stays visible at full intensity.
How strongly the ribbon curves between recorded positions. 0 gives straight lines with sharp corners.
If true, the ribbon is drawn additively and unaffected by world light.
Thin secondary streaks beside the ribbon: enabled, count, width, lifetime (ticks), opacity, color.

How the effect reacts to actual movement speed (blocks per second): minimum_trail_speed, maximum_trail_speed, intensity_curve, length_multiplier, opacity_multiplier, width_multiplier, acceleration_response (0-1 share per tick), deceleration_fade (ticks).
Block particles kicked up from the ground while running: enabled, max_per_tick, lifetime (ticks), range (blocks from the camera), turn_burst, splash.
Distance quality: beyond far_distance only a simplified ribbon is drawn, beyond cull_distance nothing.
